body:
Adam Thomas’s primer on the Lord’s Prayer for kids is just what I think we need. You can purchase it here:

 The Lord’s Prayer: Learning the Words Jesus Taught

  

 And stay tuned for a children’s book I’m working on with gifted storyteller Gareth Higgins and amazing illustrator Heather Lynn Harris … It will be called Cory and the Seventh Story … coming later this year!
